method: Crown positions approximate the lake-side planted area from the aerial photograph and 1 m canopy-height product. In mapped tree cover, locally varied green pixels within 45 m of a height sample extend the stand. A 10 m canopy-height estimate minus 0.65 times its predicted standard deviation supplies a patch-height estimate clear of structures. Existing modelled crowns and raised surfaces were masked. Individual stems, species, dimensions and ground level are estimates. Coordinates use the final scene member frame, in metres.
